messages.subject: CmdStan: Sampling in parallel - scripting
parts:
Hello Stan community,

I am having some issues with bash scripting. As described in CmdStan user guide, p.27,
I am trying to sample from 4 chains simultaneously. When typed in Bash,

> for i in {1..4}
do
./my_model sample
id=$i data file=my_data
output file=samples$i.csv &
done

does exactly what I need, but when I copy these lines to a script and execute it, I get an
error:
"""
./../../fit.sh: line 26: data: command not found
./../../fit.sh: line 27: output: command not found

Exception: variable does not exist; processing stage=data initialization; variable name=D; base type=int
Diagnostic information:
Dynamic exception type: St13runtime_error
std::exception::what: variable does not exist; processing stage=data initialization; variable name=D; base type=int
"""
(The last four lines are not really relevant - STAN just tells me it did not get the data from the data file...)

It seems I am forgetting something basic, like '\'-s at the end of the line or some quotation marks... Any ideas?

Thanks in advance,
best regards,
Arseniy.

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] CmdStan: Sampling in parallel - scripting
parts:
Hi Arseniy,

That all hast to be on a single line or you need to continue lines with a backslash (\) in bash. So... it should look like:

for i in {1..4}
do
./my_model sample id=$i data file=my_data output file=samples$i.csv &
done
